sections.overview: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus , a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.
sections.mitigation: In April 2026, the blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs found Cryptomus had processed more than $7 billion in transactions since its inception in 2022, including transactions associated with child sexual abuse material vendors, terrorist financing networks, and human trafficking operations. TRM noted that Cryptomus s transaction volume cratered after the platform instituted new know your customer or KYC rules, and that the cryptocurrency platform responded to the Canadian fines by launching Heleket as a parallel service that continued to offer no-KYC payment processing. The blockchain data-crunching firm Chainalysis said the U.K. sanctions target the broader infrastructure supporting Russia s wartime economy. Together, these services received more illicit funds across tracked categories than the mixers in our dataset and the number of illicit counterparties surged to more than 900 in a single month in late 2025.
sections.context: This aligns with ongoing ransomware campaigns targeting operational continuity and recovery readiness.

email_summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus , a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions. Heleket s support agent on Telegram claims, despite all evidence to the contrary, that it is not affiliated with Cryptomus.

title: AI-Found Linux Kernel Flaw Gives Local Users Root, and Can Break a Guest Out to the Host
